title: Your cat's purr is hiding a cry

lines: Your cat might be hiding a cry inside its purr.

beats.title: Cats purr when...
lines: But also when they're hurt, scared, or even giving birth.
So a purr doesn't always mean happy.
For decades, scientists thought every purr needed the brain to twitch the throat muscles about twenty-five times a second.
Then in 2023, researchers in Vienna showed a cat's voice box can purr with no brain signal at all, likely thanks to tiny pads in its vocal folds.

beats.label: purr
beats.source: McComb et al. (2009), Univ. of Sussex
lines: And when your cat wants food?
Researchers at Sussex found a high-pitched cry hidden in that purr, close to the pitch of a crying baby.

beats.title: Listeners rated those purrs
beats.label: MORE URGENT
lines: People rated those purrs as more urgent.
So the next time your cat purrs at breakfast, listen closely.
That's not contentment. That's a request.

sources.claim: Cats purr when content, hurt, scared, or giving birth
